verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe confirms Snyk serves a live llms.txt at docs.snyk.io/llms.txt (HTTP 200) with a structured index of its user docs that an agent can be pointed at. The docs pages are also served as markdown (.md URLs), which suits agent consumption. Missing for 10: any first-party documentation describing agent-oriented doc usage or an llms-full.txt variant, and independent corroboration of agents successfully consuming the docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://docs.snyk.io/llms.txt # Snyk User Docs
